name: popsicle
headline: Generative AI for Etsy: AI Content Generator
short_description: An AI-powered tool for generating SEO tags, product descriptions, and marketing content for Etsy and other e-commerce platforms. It uses a FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend, and integrates the Groq API for fast, generative content workflows.
author: nathija-nimantha

sections.overview:
This skill automates content creation for e-commerce sellers using AI-powered generation through the Groq API. It provides three core capabilities: generating optimized SEO tags to improve product discoverability, crafting compelling product descriptions, and creating platform-specific marketing content for social media and storefronts. The tool features a FastAPI backend and Next.js frontend with dark/light theme support, making it accessible for sellers on Etsy and other e-commerce platforms who need to scale their content production without manual writing.
Generate SEO-optimized product tags to improve Etsy search visibility
Create multiple product descriptions at scale for e-commerce inventory
Produce platform-specific marketing copy for Instagram and social media
Speed up content creation workflows for multi-product Etsy shops
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/nathija-nimantha/generative-ai-for-etsy`
sections.usage:
```
Generate 5 SEO-friendly product tags for a [PRODUCT] in the [CATEGORY] category on Etsy. Ensure they are relevant, specific, and include long-tail keywords. Also, provide a compelling 150-character product description that highlights the unique features of the [PRODUCT].
```
Copy

```
# SEO Tags for Handmade Ceramic Mugs

- Handmade ceramic mugs for coffee lovers
- Artisan crafted ceramic mugs
- Unique ceramic mugs for gifting
- Eco-friendly ceramic coffee mugs
- Custom ceramic mugs for home decor
```
